title: cis and trans [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂]
back: Square planar $\ce{MA2B2}$: cis (Cl 90° apart, anticancer cis-platin) and trans (180°).

title: Isomers of [CoCl₂(en)₂]⁺
back: Three isomers: trans (optically inactive) and a cis pair, d and l, that are optical isomers.

title: Crystal-field splitting
back: Octahedral: $e_g$ up $0.6\Delta_o$, $t_{2g}$ down $0.4\Delta_o$. Tetrahedral: inverted and smaller, $\Delta_t=\tfrac49\Delta_o$.

title: Oxidation number of the metal
legend: x = oxidation state of the metal
q_\text{L} = ligand charges (NH₃, H₂O, CO, en are 0)
back: $\ce{K3[Fe(CN)6]}$: $x-6=-3$, so Fe is +3. Ni in $\ce{[Ni(CO)4]}$ is 0.

title: Coordination number
back: Count donor atoms, not ligands: $\ce{[Co(en)3]^3+}$ has CN 6.

title: Crystal field stabilisation energy
back: Low spin when $\Delta_o>P$ (strong field); high spin when $\Delta_o<P$.

title: Double salt vs complex
back: A double salt gives all its ions in water; a complex ion stays intact.

title: Spectrochemical series
back: "I Bought Some Cool Summer Frocks; Only One Was Nice, Even Now Everyone Complains Cost."

title: cis sisters, trans strangers
back: cis: like ligands sit together; trans: they sit across.

title: Ambidentate ligands
back: One ligand, two possible donor atoms: this gives linkage isomerism, e.g. nitrito-N and nitrito-O complexes.

title: Chelate effect
back: A ligand that grips with two or more atoms forms rings and a more stable complex than similar unidentate ligands.

title: Inner vs outer orbital complex
back: NH₃ pairs the d electrons (inner, low spin, diamagnetic); F⁻ does not (outer, high spin, 4 unpaired, 4.90 BM).

title: VBT boxes: [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ vs [CoF₆]³⁻
back: NH₃ pairs 3d⁶ → d²sp³, inner orbital, diamagnetic. F⁻ does not → sp³d², outer orbital, 4 unpaired, paramagnetic.
